examples.english: What will you have for lunch?

examples.english: I ate lunch together with a friend today.

examples.japanese: お{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: It was lunchtime, so we all went to the cafeteria.

notes:
{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん} is the informal word for lunch, the midday meal.

MEAL VOCABULARY:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧: breakfast
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}: lunch
- ⟦{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧/⟦{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}→夜ご飯：12332_yorugohan⟧: dinner

ALTERNATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧: lunch (formal, often used in business)
- ⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧: lunch (casual, from English)
- ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: lunch (casual abbreviation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat lunch
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go for lunch
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧?: What shall we have for lunch?

USAGE:
⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ literally means 'cooked rice' but is commonly used to mean 'meal'. In casual speech, ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ alone can mean lunch: ⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧? (Did you eat lunch?)
